# ADR-3254: AWS security_groups: Documented temporary world-open rule for migration 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Short migrations sometimes need open access.

## Decision

Migrators MAY adopt a documented temporary world-open rule for migration 6 (AWS-security_groups-6) when cutovers need broad testing.

## Consequences

Rules expire automatically.
